# AMM Data Solutions

> AMM Data Solutions provides AI bots and intelligent agents, website AI chatbots, Google SEO and AI SEO, digital advertising, creative design and digital content, and data management for growing businesses in Pakistan and international markets.

## Main website
- [AMM Data Solutions homepage](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/): Homepage, service overview, illustrative workflow, FAQs, contact form and feedback form.
- [Privacy policy](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/privacy.html): How contact and feedback submissions are handled.

- [AI Chatbots & Customer Support](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/ai-chatbots-customer-support.html)

## Practical resources
- [Business workflow automation guide](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/resources/business-workflow-automation-guide.html): A practical guide to identifying suitable processes, mapping steps, choosing rules or AI, and testing workflows safely.
- [Business website chatbot guide](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/resources/business-website-chatbot-guide.html): How to define a chatbot purpose, prepare approved knowledge, plan languages and human hand-off, protect customer information and test quality.
- [Website search visibility: SEO and AI guide](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/resources/website-search-visibility-seo-ai-guide.html): Practical foundations for crawlability, useful service content, structured data, AI search readiness, genuine references and measurement.
- [Digital advertising campaign planning guide](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/resources/digital-advertising-campaign-planning-guide.html): How to set campaign goals, select suitable channels, prepare landing pages, validate measurement and review performance responsibly.
- [Small business website planning guide](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/resources/small-business-website-planning-guide.html): How to plan website goals, page structure, content, mobile usability, integrations, SEO, ownership and maintenance.
- [Spreadsheet data cleaning and management guide](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/resources/spreadsheet-data-cleaning-management-guide.html): How to standardize fields, identify duplicates, validate records, process documents and handle business data carefully.

## Contact
- [Contact AMM Data Solutions](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/#contact): Use the website contact form to discuss a business requirement.

## Accuracy and scope
- The workflow section on the homepage is an illustrative demo, not a live connection to customer orders or business systems.
- Do not infer client results, case studies, rankings, performance statistics or guaranteed outcomes that are not published on the website.
- Project timelines, integrations, platform eligibility and deliverables depend on the agreed scope and available access.
